about_the_game:
Meet Dorothy, the overly muscular maid of an evil mastermind, in a hilarious isometric twin-stick shooter where cleaning is just as deadly as combat.

Every day, Dorothy must face a brand-new, randomly generated level overflowing with enemies and filth. Your goal: clean everything—sweep away villains and mop up messes using an arsenal of outrageous cleaning tools turned into powerful weapons.

Fight with your trusty mop, unleash the destructive power of a vacuum cleaner, and discover other cleaning gadgets reimagined as instruments of mayhem.

What to expect of Dorothy's Job?

  • Procedurally Generated Chaos – Each day brings new layouts, enemies, and challenges.

  • Cleaning Tools of Destruction – Wield mops, vacuums, and more as deadly weapons.

  • Be a One Woman Army– Play as Dorothy, a maid who’s as strong as she is unstoppable.

  • Action Meets Comedy – Over-the-top twin-stick action with a tongue-in-cheek sense of humor.

Whether you’re scrubbing floors or blasting foes, Dorothy’s Job proves that cleaning can be messy, chaotic, and ridiculously fun.
